description: This file defines the AlarmDao interface for alarm data access operations within the Thingsboard platform, including methods for querying, updating, and managing alarms and related records.

classes.name: AlarmDao
classes.description: Interface for alarm data access operations, extending generic Dao interface for Alarm entities.

methods.name: findLatestByOriginatorAndType
methods.description: Finds the latest alarm by originator and type.

methods.name: findLatestActiveByOriginatorAndType
methods.description: Finds the latest active alarm by originator and type.

methods.name: findLatestActiveByOriginatorAndTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds the latest active alarm by originator and type.

methods.name: findLatestByOriginatorAndTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds the latest alarm by originator and type.

methods.name: findAlarmById
methods.description: Finds an alarm by its ID.

methods.name: findAlarmByIdAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds an alarm by its ID.

methods.name: findAlarmInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves alarm info by ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates an alarm.

methods.name: findAlarms
methods.description: Finds alarms based on query parameters.

methods.name: findCustomerAlarms
methods.description: Finds alarms for a specific customer.

methods.name: findAlarmsV2
methods.description: Finds alarms using version 2 query.

methods.name: findCustomerAlarmsV2
methods.description: Finds customer alarms using version 2 query.

methods.name: findAlarmDataByQueryForEntities
methods.description: Finds alarm data for specific entities based on query.

methods.name: findAlarmSeverities
methods.description: Finds alarm severities for an entity.

methods.name: findAlarmsIdsByEndTsBeforeAndTenantId
methods.description: Finds alarm IDs with end timestamp before a specified time.

methods.name: findAlarmIdsByAssigneeId
methods.description: Finds alarm IDs assigned to a user.

methods.name: findAlarmIdsByOriginatorId
methods.description: Finds alarm IDs by originator ID.

methods.name: createEntityAlarmRecord
methods.description: Creates a record linking an entity to an alarm.

methods.name: findEntityAlarmRecords
methods.description: Finds entity alarm records by alarm ID.

methods.name: findEntityAlarmRecordsByEntityId
methods.description: Finds entity alarm records by entity ID.

methods.name: deleteEntityAlarmRecords
methods.description: Deletes entity alarm records for an entity.

methods.name: deleteEntityAlarmRecordsByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all entity alarm records for a tenant.

methods.name: createOrUpdateActiveAlarm
methods.description: Creates or updates an active alarm.

methods.name: updateAlarm
methods.description: Updates an alarm.

methods.name: acknowledgeAlarm
methods.description: Acknowledges an alarm.

methods.name: clearAlarm
methods.description: Clears an alarm.

methods.name: assignAlarm
methods.description: Assigns an alarm to a user.

methods.name: unassignAlarm
methods.description: Unassigns an alarm.

methods.name: countAlarmsByQuery
methods.description: Counts alarms based on query.

methods.name: findTenantAlarmTypes
methods.description: Finds alarm types for a tenant.

methods.name: removeAlarmTypesIfNoAlarmsPresent
methods.description: Removes alarm types if no alarms are present.

methods.name: findActiveOriginatorAlarms
methods.description: Finds active originator alarms.
